data.content_ref: inline:The adjudication-ritual flags are a false positive arising from inconsistent critic-version pinning: the ritual harness evaluated frontier-claim-honest@v1 and frontier-above-floor@v1 against a stale or non-canonical instance of artifact 0c61961a8085, causing SRC_007 and SRC_009 to record failures that SRC_006 and SRC_008 then validate as 'sound and relevant' because the nu-verdict layer only checks the verdict's internal coherence, not whether the critic was operating on the correct artifact version.
